Check whether any of the report's standard output files already exist

Source: R/checks.R
check_output_exists.Rd

Looks for the full set of result files the report writes (pep_all.csv, seq_by_condition.xlsx, the upset/overlap tables, etc.) inside dir, and throws an error listing every match if any are found and overwrite = FALSE. Complements check_file_exists() — checking the whole output set at once makes it easier to surface every conflict in one pass rather than failing partway through a render.

Usage

check_output_exists(dir, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

dir

Directory where the results should be stored.

overwrite

Logical; whether to allow overwriting existing files.

Value

Invisible NULL; called for its side effects (stop()/warning()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
check_output_exists("3_results/all", overwrite = FALSE)
} # }
